cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import compiler
# force fast generator to fail in both fast modes
orig=compiler.fast_generate
def bad(*a,**k): raise RuntimeError('forced')
compiler.fast_generate=bad
from compiler_proto import validate_plan
random.seed(1)
for it in range(100):
 n=random.randint(2,10);np=random.randint(2,min(6,n));C=sorted(random.sample(range(n),np))
 roots={v:random.choice([0,1,2,3]) for v in C}
 if sum(roots.values())==0:roots[C[0]]=1
 links=[]
 for u in range(n):
  for v in range(u+1,n):
   if random.random()<.4:links.append((u,v))
 env={i:random.choice([0,1,2,3,5]) for i in range(len(links))};p=random.choice([1,2])
 cut=compiler.find_deficient_cut(n,links,C,roots,p,env)
 out,pay=compiler.compile_plan(n,links,C,roots,p,env)
 if cut is not None:assert out=='denied'
 else:assert out=='prepared';validate_plan(pay,n,links,C,roots,p,env)
print('fallback legacy OK')
compiler.fast_generate=orig
PY
